title: Econ regressions
tagline: Extract every regression from an empirical-economics paper, classify headlines, rate confidence per data block
description: Empirical-economics regression extractor.  Walks every results table in the paper and emits one sample per table — with the table's full set of regression columns rendered side-by-side under four sub-tabs (Metadata, Specification, Estimates, Classification) plus a Paper metadata tab.  Built to mirror how empirical-economics tables are actually read.
task_description: Extract every regression reported in the paper's tables — coefficients, standard errors, controls, sample size, model type, and headline classification — grouped by source table.  Each sample is one results table; each column within a table is one regression.
context: Empirical-economics workflow for primary studies that report regression results in tables (typical AEJ / AER / QJE format).  One sample per table; the table's columns become the columns of the rendered display.
